_meta.what: Hand-compiled Odisha ecosystem layers: indicative orgs, funders, government schemes and the Vision 2036 pillars. Every row traces to a public source. NOT independently field-verified; treat as leads. District names use model.json canon spelling.
_meta.confidence_legend: high = enumerated on the org's own site/report; med = count/partial or third-party; low = single directory/search-synthesis

anchors._note: Multi-district anchor orgs. CYSD's named field-office districts are used as the concrete anchor-presence set. Gram Vikas / Harsha Trust / Niyatee are large multi-district anchors whose per-district lists aren't cleanly enumerated publicly, so they're listed as anchors without per-district paint.

vision2036._note: Odisha Vision 2036 (state centenary) + 2047 horizon, unveiled by the PM on 12 Jun 2025 (BJP govt first anniversary) alongside 105 projects worth ~₹18,600 Cr. Odisha is the first state to use an AI-assisted, 3.2-lakh-citizen-suggestion vision process. 36 flagship 'Developed Odisha by 2036' programmes across 36 areas. Figures from govt announcements & press; treat as stated targets, not audited outcomes.
vision2036.headline: A $500 billion economy by 2036, $1.5 trillion by 2047

trajectory._note: Direction of travel of the ecosystem + public money behind each pillar (a read, not a time series): Accelerating / Steady / Emerging / Lagging.

Economy & Industry.why: BCKIC innovation cluster + industrial CSR (JSW, NALCO, BPCL) are early green shoots, but no broad development-partner base yet.

Employment & Skills.why: Samagra Shiksha + HDFC Parivartan + BCKIC STEM; still narrow vs the 5-lakh-jobs/yr pace.

Urbanisation & Infrastructure.why: ANKUR announced, but almost no mapped civil-society/urban partner; the toughest velocity gap (17%→40%).

Agriculture & Rural.why: CM-KISAN ₹2,020 Cr + Shree Anna ₹600 Cr + Gates ADAPT + FPOs + Model Mandi converging.

Education & Health.why: AB-PMJAY ₹711 Cr + BSKY + PM POSHAN + Piramal/Gates/UNICEF; dense partner base.

Women's Empowerment.why: Subhadra ₹10,145 Cr + Mission Shakti + ~5.6L SHGs + Gates/WFP — the fastest-moving pillar.

Governance & Asmita.why: AI-assisted vision process + regional councils; ecosystem role thin.
